title: ONIQ EngineeringMeasurement
description: One measurement taken from an asset that already exists. The engine is read-only: it renders nothing and generates nothing. measurement_domain is MANDATORY and domains are never mixed. MILLIMETRE is deliberately absent from the enum: it requires a scale bridge ONIQ does not have, so no measurement can be emitted in it. A measurement never sets productionEligible — promotion is a separate, evidence-gated act.

measurement_domain.description: MILLIMETRE is intentionally not permitted — see ENGINEERING_SCALE_BRIDGE_STATUS.md

validationState.description: PROMOTED is intentionally absent — it can never be set automatically
